profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, trading under the ticker MU. On its own site it describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, saying it powers AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions. It also says mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies that enable predictive and insightful experiences for end users.

The site's material is aimed largely at engineers and buyers. It offers data sheets to search, filter and download, design tools and resources for testing, building and maintaining high-performance solutions, technical documentation, and an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples. It also points visitors to a Technology Enablement Program (TEP) and to sales support.

Beyond that, the record is thin. No products are tracked for the company and no MCP servers are listed. Its litigation record shows 17 cases in Idaho. Corporate filings identify it by CIK 0000723125.
